exposure: World Health Organization Labour Care Guide
Old modified World Health Organization partograph
cohort: The study participants were patients brought to the labor room at the division of Obstetrics & Gynaecology AJIMS, Mangalore.
finding: The World Health Organization Labour Care Guide was found to be an effective labor surveillance instrument that helped minimize the incidence of initial cesarean delivery by 1.5%.
mod_finding: The World Health Organization Labour Care Guide was beneficial in minimizing the incidence of initial cesarean delivery by 1.5%.
